summary: PropManage Operations Center (COO Directive) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 22/22 pass on /app/backend/tests/test_operations_center_iter128.py: GET /api/admin/operations returns proper shape (stages, manual_methods, leads with 'id' field no '_id', gaps, coo_report with new_leads_today/open_leads/revenue_pending_ron/payments_received_real/manual_payments_count/manual_payments_total_ron/biggest_bottleneck/top_founder_action, one_win today/yesterday); PATCH /leads/{id} validates lead id (404 bad), stage whitelist (400 invalid), and persists stage=contacted + note + next_action; GET /gaps?status=open returns records+summary(total_open/waiting_customers/est_lost_revenue_ron/by_city/by_category); /gaps?status=all works; /gaps/export returns text/csv with attachment header and correct header row; /gaps/{id}/candidates returns candidates + fallback flag (404 for bad gap id); POST /manual-payments validates method (400 for 'bitcoin'), amount 0/negative (400), missing customer+no lead (400), invalid lead (404), and creates VERIFIED cash payment 123.45 RON (post-count = pre+1, status=verified, method=cash); GET /manual-payments returns payments+totals; POST /win rejects empty (400) and persists text visible in one_win.today; regression /api/admin/war-room 200. Frontend Playwright on https://phased-document.preview.emergentagent.com/admin/operations after admin login: all key sections visible (ops-title, ops-coo-report, ops-one-win, ops-pipeline, ops-gap-engine, ops-payments-panel, gap-summary, payments-total, ops-bottleneck); ONE_WIN save+refresh shows new win text; pipeline lists 50 leads with per-row stage select + note input+save; gap engine shows 3 open gaps, gap-export-btn href contains /gaps/export, filter dropdowns present, candidates panel expands with 5 assign buttons; Manual Payment form creates 77 RON cash payment linked to 'UI-iter128 Test Customer' — totals moved 573,45 → 650,45 RON and new row shows VERIFIED badge. /admin dashboard still loads. window.confirm dialogs auto-accepted.

minor.issue: Not the real path — first_revenue router is mounted under /api/admin/war-room. Test uses correct path; update request description or add alias if desired.

action_items: (Optional) Add /api/first-revenue/summary alias or update request description — the actual endpoint is /api/admin/war-room.
critical_code_review_comments: operations_center.py _sync_gaps() runs on every GET /operations and every GET /gaps — for large request volumes this is a hot path; consider async task/cron or debouncing.
PATCH /leads/{id}: 'next_action' accepts any string via payload but only trimmed to 300 chars — no XSS sanitation. Frontend renders as text so acceptable, but log injection possible in ops_notes.
POST /manual-payments: when both lead_id and request_id provided, no consistency check that request belongs to same client as lead. Low priority since admin-only.
POST /manual-payments auto-increments lead.revenue_generated but never decrements on payment reversal (no delete/refund endpoint yet).
OperationsCenter.jsx uses alert()/window.confirm() — works in Playwright with dialog handler but poor UX; prefer shadcn AlertDialog.
gap-export-btn is a plain <a href> — for cookie-auth this works, but downloading without triggering CSRF checks; low risk since GET-only.
LeadRow.select doesn't show a loading/disabled visual while PATCH is in-flight (only disables when busy===lead.id, but the whole page reload masks failures).

One 'UI-iter128 win ...' entry in db.daily_wins for today. First lead stage was moved to 'contacted' with next_action 'TEST_iter128 next'. Delete with db.manual_payments.delete_many({customer_name:{$regex:'iter128'}}) and db.daily_wins.delete_many({text:{$regex:'iter128'}}) if pollution matters. No open gaps were assigned — 3 open gaps preserved as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Operations Center fully green backend + UI. 3 open gaps remain (categories: general + other x2) — assign at most one to avoid depleting test data, or POST a fresh open request first. Manual Payment endpoint is /api/admin/operations/manual-payments (POST/GET), separate from /manual-payment (single) which is for Verified Estate order flow. The stage select persists correctly (backend PATCH assertion confirmed); reading current value via Playwright requires page.eval_on_selector or input_value(), not get_attribute('value'). first_revenue endpoint is /api/admin/war-room (not /api/first-revenue/summary).
